items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They made a movie called “Jazz Dance” . . . with a lot of dancers, like Honi Coles. People like that were in it. I played a lot of those gigs.

ctx.x: So he was the original bassist when you started at the Embers?

No, the bassist . . . what people I had at the Embers, I just had the one group. The first time I had Eddie Safranski, who had just left Stan Kenton. He was trying to make it in the studios in New York. And Don Lamond, who had just left Woody and who was doing the same thing, wanted to be in the studios. So they took this gig with me, and they couldn’t have been nicer, except Don Lamond had . . . they both had a bit of a drinking problem, I think. They used to take me to a bar on Third Avenue between sets.…
